eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN IMMEDIATE EVACUATION NOTICE for the following counties or areas: Klamath, OR; at 1:34 PM on AUG 17, 2026 Effective until 4:34 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text:
This is an emergency notice from the Klamath County Sheriff. The following areas are being issued a Level 3 (GO NOW) evacuation notice due to wildfire: Winema National Forest South and West of Sprague River Road. Level 3 means leave immediately! Do NOT take time to gather things. GO NOW! More information at https://protect.genasys.com/en/fullscreenMap?lat=42.4631&lng=-121.6034&z=10.3 Level 3 means leave immediately! DO NOT DELAY leaving to gather items or to try to protect your home. GO NOW!
 
Failure to evacuate may result in injury or death. Drive carefully, turn on your headlights, and follow any directions from responders.

If you choose to ignore this notice, responders may not be available to assist you further. 

--

Nivel 3 significa significa váyase inmediatamente. NO se detenga para recolectar sus pertenencias. VÁYASE YA!

Hay peligro inmediato y debe evacuar inmediatamente. NO demore la salida de su propiedad para recolectar sus pertenencias o hacer esfuerzos para proteger su hogar. Váyase inmediatamente y lo más rápido posible. Conduzca con cuidado, encienda los faros y siga las indicaciones del personal de seguridad pública.

Si decide no hacer caso a este aviso, es posible que el personal de seguridad pública no esté disponible para prestar más ayuda. NO se demore en irse para recolectar sus pertenencias o hacer esfuerzos para proteger su hogar.
